item.title: FAQ
item.description: Lazurite is a blue rock like material, it was a precious material. So as the founder likes the color blue, thus Lazursoft was made. It took a while to realize, but I do in fact enjoy solving problems in hardware and software. And instead of chasing an imaginary role in an office, I enjoyed being out on call and troubleshooting all the ways data flows. So after freelancing for a while, I decided to start this small enterprise, where anyone from a frustrated worker dealing with a busted printer, a startup looking for assisstance, or someone needing help with software can seek assisstance.

item.title: Support
item.description: Convientent assisstance Lazursoft isn’t above fixing hardware or software problems. We have solved issues in everywhere from data centers and offices to active retail spaces. Support services provided by Lazursoft include: General assistance: When everything that usually works by itself stops working, we thrive in making it work again. Example cases: Guest devices can’t connect to the customer’s wireless network. Fixing a used printer that doesn’t work. Remote: 15,000 won; in-person 30,000 won for 1 hour of work Industry assistance: For the larger more time consuming cases.
